description: This file defines the CommentViewBuilder class for rendering comment entities in Drupal, including methods for building and altering comment display components, managing threading, and integrating with Drupal's entity and theme systems.

classes.name: CommentViewBuilder
classes.description: A class extending EntityViewBuilder to handle rendering of comment entities with threading and display customization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for comment view building.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of CommentViewBuilder with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getBuildDefaults
methods.description: Provides default build array for comment entities, including threading settings.

methods.name: buildComponents
methods.description: Builds the render array for comment entities, managing threading indentation and display links.

methods.name: alterBuild
methods.description: Alters the build array to add indentation and closing divs for threaded comments.
